name: Privileged Group Membership Change (T1098, internal ref CSCRF-ID-01)
blast_radius: Creates one synthetic local account, adds it to and removes it from Administrators, and deletes it in undo. Runs only with BAS_CONFIRM_IDENTITY_CHANGE=true.

name: Local Administrator Account Creation (T1136.001, internal ref CSCRF-ID-02)
blast_radius: Creates one synthetic local account placed directly in Administrators, deleted in undo. Runs only with BAS_CONFIRM_IDENTITY_CHANGE=true.
detection: Local admin account creation alert (EID 4720 with 4732)

name: Privileged Account Logon Monitoring (T1078, internal ref CSCRF-ID-03)
blast_radius: Read-only query of the Security log for recent logon events.

name: Excessive Administrators Membership (T1078, internal ref CSCRF-ID-04)
blast_radius: Read-only query of Administrators group membership.

name: Disabled Account Logon Attempt (T1078, internal ref CSCRF-ID-05)
blast_radius: Creates one synthetic local account, disables it, attempts a logon with its own credentials, and deletes it in undo. Runs only with BAS_CONFIRM_IDENTITY_CHANGE=true.
telemetry: Failed logon for a disabled account

name: Local Password Policy Baseline (CSCRF-ID-06)
blast_radius: Read-only query of the local account policy.

name: MFA Enforcement (CSCRF-ID-07)
blast_radius: None. Reports SKIP; no identity provider is integrated.

name: Service Account Administrator Rights (T1078.003, internal ref CSCRF-ID-08)
blast_radius: Read-only query of service accounts and Administrators membership.
